Specific generation article explicitly gives late 2004 to early 2015 production. The whole-line overview's 2005 start was not used.

The source calls V5 both a second generation and a slight facelift of the original. Kept original/V5 as one construction family, followed by the new 2017 sedan. Factory type codes remain empty. Both existing Pakistan technical versions moved intact to index 1.
Source explicitly says FC2 and FC3 retain the original FC platform; treated as facelifts. FC3 unveiling late 2017 is distinct from the listed 2018 production start.
Model-specific lead explicitly says production 1967–1983. The inconsistent 1965 start in the infobox was rejected; first-year factory boundary still warrants a primary-document check.
Only the explicitly named GMC S-15/Sonoma first and second North American generations were assigned. Brazil's continuing Chevrolet production was excluded.

Kept one construction family covering successive makers, with source periods 1993–2007 and 2011–2013. These are family dates, not proof of uninterrupted production under the Daewoo badge. The existing matcher uses generation envelopes and cannot reject the internal 2008–2010 pause.
